title: fix: Pass nbHits, hitsPerPage, nbPages and page to Stats widget

comments.body: Nice! Though I thought we were going to pass the whole result object (https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/106#issuecomment-142006120)
This seemed to be overkill for such a small widget. And we're already adding new keys, it might be better to return a whole different object.
